title: Juzz : 24
introduction:
SURAH AL-MU’MIN (THE BELIEVER) OR SURAH GHAFIR

SURAH HAMIM SAJDAH OR FUSSILAT

verses.arabic: فَمَنْ اَظْلَمُ مِمَّنْ كَذَبَ عَلَى اللّٰهِ وَكَذَّبَ بِالصِّدْقِ اِذْ جَآءَهٗ‌ ؕ اَ لَيْسَ فِىْ جَهَنَّمَ مَثْوًى لِّلْكٰفِرِيْنَ‏(32)
verses.translation: (32) Who is then more unjust than he who utters a lie against Allah and (he who) gives the lie to the truth when it comes to him; is there not in hell an abode for the unbelievers?

verses.arabic: وَالَّذِىْ جَآءَ بِالصِّدْقِ وَصَدَّقَ بِهٖۤ‌ اُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْمُتَّقُوْنَ‏(33)
verses.translation: (33) And he who brings the truth and (he who) accepts it as the truth-- these are they that guard (against evil).

verses.arabic: لَهُمْ مَّا يَشَآءُوْنَ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ‌ ؕ ذٰ لِكَ جَزٰٓؤُ الْمُحْسِنِيْنَ ۖۚ‏(34)
verses.translation: (34) They shall have with their Lord what they please; that is the reward of the doers of good;

verses.arabic: لِيُكَفِّرَ اللّٰهُ عَنْهُمْ اَسْوَاَ الَّذِىْ عَمِلُوْا وَيَجْزِيَهُمْ اَجْرَهُمْ بِاَحْسَنِ الَّذِىْ كَانُوْا يَعْمَلُوْنَ‏(35)
verses.translation: (35) So that Allah will do away with the worst of what they did and give them their reward for the best of what they do.

verses.arabic: اَلَيْسَ اللّٰهُ بِكَافٍ عَبْدَهٗ‌ ؕ وَيُخَوِّفُوْنَكَ بِالَّذِيْنَ مِنْ دُوْنِهٖ‌ ؕ وَمَنْ يُّضْلِلِ اللّٰهُ فَمَا لَهٗ مِنْ هَادٍ‌ ۚ‏(36)
verses.translation: (36) Is not Allah sufficient for His servant? And they seek to frighten you with those besides Him; and whomsoever Allah makes err, there is no guide for him.

verses.arabic: وَمَنْ يَّهْدِ اللّٰهُ فَمَا لَهٗ مِنْ مُّضِلٍّ‌ ؕ اَ لَيْسَ اللّٰهُ بِعَزِيْزٍ ذِى انْتِقَامٍ‏(37)
verses.translation: (37) And whom Allah guides, there is none that can lead him astray; is not Allah Mighty, the Lord of retribution?

verses.arabic: وَلَئِنْ سَاَ لْتَهُمْ مَّنْ خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضَ لَيَقُوْلُنَّ اللّٰهُ‌ ؕ قُلْ اَفَرَءَيْتُمْ مَّا تَدْعُوْنَ مِنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ اِنْ اَرَادَنِىَ اللّٰهُ بِضُرٍّ هَلْ هُنَّ كٰشِفٰتُ ضُرِّهٖۤ اَوْ اَرَادَنِىْ بِرَحْمَةٍ هَلْ هُنَّ مُمْسِكٰتُ رَحْمَتِهٖ‌ ؕ قُلْ حَسْبِىَ اللّٰهُ‌ ؕ عَلَيْهِ يَتَوَكَّلُ الْمُتَوَكِّلُوْنَ‏(38)
verses.translation: (38) And should you ask them, Who created the heavens and the earth? They would most certainly say: Allah. Say: Have you then considered that what you call upon besides Allah, would they, if Allah desire to afflict me with harm, be the removers of His harm, or (would they), if Allah desire to show me mercy, be the withholders of His mercy? Say: Allah is sufficient for me; on Him do the reliant rely.

verses.arabic: قُلْ يٰقَوْمِ اعْمَلُوْا عَلٰى مَكَانَتِكُمْ اِنِّىْ عَامِلٌ‌ۚ فَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُوْنَۙ‏(39)
verses.translation: (39) Say: O my people! work in your place, surely I am a worker, so you will come to know.

verses.arabic: مَنْ يَّاْتِيْهِ عَذَابٌ يُّخْزِيْهِ وَيَحِلُّ عَلَيْهِ عَذَابٌ مُّقِيْمٌ‏(40)
verses.translation: (40) Who it is to whom there shall come a punishment which will disgrace him and to whom will be due a lasting punishment.

verses.arabic: اِنَّاۤ اَنْزَلْنَا عَلَيْكَ الْكِتٰبَ لِلنَّاسِ بِالْحَقِّ‌ ۚ فَمَنِ اهْتَدٰى فَلِنَفْسِهٖ‌ ۚ وَمَنْ ضَلَّ فَاِنَّمَا يَضِلُّ عَلَيْهَا‌ ۚ وَمَاۤ اَنْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ بِوَكِيْلٍ‏(41)
verses.translation: (41) Surely We have revealed to you the Book with the truth for the sake of men; so whoever follows the right way, it is for his own soul and whoever errs, he errs only to its detriment; and you are not a custodian over them.

verses.arabic: اَللّٰهُ يَتَوَفَّى الْاَنْفُسَ حِيْنَ مَوْتِهَا وَالَّتِىْ لَمْ تَمُتْ فِىْ مَنَامِهَا‌ ۚ فَيُمْسِكُ الَّتِىْ قَضٰى عَلَيْهَا الْمَوْتَ وَ يُرْسِلُ الْاُخْرٰٓى اِلٰٓى اَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى‌ ؕ اِنَّ فِىْ ذٰ لِكَ لَاٰیٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يَّتَفَكَّرُوْنَ‏(42)
verses.translation: (42) Allah takes the souls at the time of their death, and those that die not during their sleep; then He withholds those on whom He has passed the decree of death and sends the others back till an appointed term; most surely there are signs in this for a people who reflect.

verses.arabic: اَمِ اتَّخَذُوْا مِنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ شُفَعَآءَ‌ ؕ قُلْ اَوَلَوْ كَانُوْا لَا يَمْلِكُوْنَ شَيْئًا وَّلَا يَعْقِلُوْنَ‏(43)
verses.translation: (43) Or have they taken intercessors besides Allah? Say: what! even though they did not ever have control over anything, nor do they understand.

verses.arabic: قُلْ لِّلَّهِ الشَّفَاعَةُ جَمِيْعًا‌ ؕ لَهٗ مُلْكُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِ‌ ؕ ثُمَّ اِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُوْنَ‏(44)
verses.translation: (44) Say: Allah's is the intercession altogether; His is the kingdom of the heavens and the earth, then to Him you shall be brought back.

verses.arabic: وَاِذَا ذُكِرَ اللّٰهُ وَحْدَهُ اشْمَاَزَّتْ قُلُوْبُ الَّذِيْنَ لَا يُؤْمِنُوْنَ بِالْاٰخِرَةِ‌ ۚ وَاِذَا ذُكِرَ الَّذِيْنَ مِنْ دُوْنِهٖۤ اِذَا هُمْ يَسْتَبْشِرُوْنَ‏(45)
verses.translation: (45) And when Allah alone is mentioned, the hearts of those who do not believe in the hereafter shrink, and when those besides Him are mentioned, lo! they are joyful.

verses.arabic: قُلِ اللّٰهُمَّ فَاطِرَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِ عٰلِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ اَنْتَ تَحْكُمُ بَيْنَ عِبَادِكَ فِىْ مَا كَانُوْا فِيْهِ يَخْتَلِفُوْنَ‏(46)
verses.translation: (46) Say: O Allah! Originator of the heavens and the earth, Knower of the unseen and the seen! Thou (only) judgest between Thy servants as to that wherein they differ.

verses.arabic: وَلَوْ اَنَّ لِلَّذِيْنَ ظَلَمُوْا مَا فِى الْاَرْضِ جَمِيْعًا وَّمِثْلَهٗ مَعَهٗ لَافْتَدَوْا بِهٖ مِنْ سُوْٓءِ الْعَذَابِ يَوْمَ الْقِيٰمَةِ‌ؕ وَبَدَا لَهُمْ مِّنَ اللّٰهِ مَا لَمْ يَكُوْنُوْا يَحْتَسِبُوْنَ‏(47)
verses.translation: (47) And had those who are unjust all that is in the earth and the like of it with it, they would certainly offer it as ransom (to be saved) from the evil of the punishment on the day of resurrection; and what they never thought of shall become plain to them from Allah.

verses.arabic: وَبَدَا لَهُمْ سَيِّاٰتُ مَا كَسَبُوْا وَحَاقَ بِهِمْ مَّا كَانُوْا بِهٖ يَسْتَهْزِءُوْنَ‏(48)
verses.translation: (48) And the evil (consequences) of what they wrought shall become plain to them, and the very thing they mocked at shall beset them.

verses.arabic: فَاِذَا مَسَّ الْاِنْسَانَ ضُرٌّ دَعَانَا ثُمَّ اِذَا خَوَّلْنٰهُ نِعْمَةً مِّنَّا ۙ قَالَ اِنَّمَاۤ اُوْتِيْتُهٗ عَلٰى عِلْمٍ‌ؕ بَلْ هِىَ فِتْنَةٌ وَّلٰكِنَّ اَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُوْنَ‏(49)
verses.translation: (49) So when harm afflicts a man he calls upon Us; then, when We give him a favor from Us, he says: I have been given it only by means of knowledge. Nay, it is a trial, but most of them do not know.

verses.arabic: قَدْ قَالَهَا الَّذِيْنَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ فَمَاۤ اَغْنٰى عَنْهُمْ مَّا كَانُوْا يَكْسِبُوْنَ‏(50)
verses.translation: (50) Those before them did say it indeed, but what they earned availed them not.

verses.arabic: فَاَصَابَهُمْ سَيِّاٰتُ مَا كَسَبُوْا‌ ؕ وَالَّذِيْنَ ظَلَمُوْا مِنْ هٰٓؤُلَاۤءِ سَيُصِيْبُهُمْ سَيِّاٰتُ مَا كَسَبُوْا ۙ وَمَا هُمْ بِمُعْجِزِيْنَ‏(51)
verses.translation: (51) So there befell them the evil (consequences) of what they earned; and (as for) those who are unjust from among these, there shall befall them the evil (consequences) of what they earn, and they shall not escape.

verses.arabic: اَوَلَمْ يَعْلَمُوْۤا اَنَّ اللّٰهَ يَبْسُطُ الرِّزْقَ لِمَنْ يَّشَآءُ وَيَقْدِرُ‌ؕ اِنَّ فِىْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يُّؤْمِنُوْنَ‏(52)
verses.translation: (52) Do they not know that Allah makes ample the means of subsistence to whom He pleases, and He straitens; most surely there are signs in this for a people who believe.

verses.arabic: قُلْ يٰعِبَادِىَ الَّذِيْنَ اَسْرَفُوْا عَلٰٓى اَنْفُسِهِمْ لَا تَقْنَطُوْا مِنْ رَّحْمَةِ اللّٰهِ‌ ؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوْبَ جَمِيْعًا‌ ؕ اِنَّهٗ هُوَ الْغَفُوْرُ الرَّحِيْمُ‏(53)
verses.translation: (53) Say: O my servants! who have acted extravagantly against their own souls, do not despair of the mercy of Allah; surely Allah forgives the faults altogether; surely He is the Forgiving the Merciful.

verses.arabic: وَاَنِيْبُوْۤا اِلٰى رَبِّكُمْ وَاَسْلِمُوْا لَهٗ مِنْ قَبْلِ اَنْ يَّاْتِيَكُمُ الْعَذَابُ ثُمَّ لَا تُنْصَرُوْنَ‏(54)
verses.translation: (54) And return to your Lord time after time and submit to Him before there comes to you the punishment, then you shall not be helped.

verses.arabic: وَاتَّبِعُوْۤا اَحْسَنَ مَاۤ اُنْزِلَ اِلَيْكُمْ مِّنْ رَّبِّكُمْ مِّنْ قَبْلِ اَنْ يَّاْتِيَكُمُ الْعَذَابُ بَغْتَةً وَّاَنْتُمْ لَا تَشْعُرُوْنَۙ‏(55)
verses.translation: (55) And follow the best that has been revealed to you from your Lord before there comes to you the punishment all of a sudden while you do not even perceive;

verses.arabic: اَنْ تَقُوْلَ نَفْسٌ يّٰحَسْرَتٰى عَلٰى مَا فَرَّطْتُّ فِىْ جَنْۢبِ اللّٰهِ وَاِنْ كُنْتُ لَمِنَ السّٰخِرِيْنَۙ‏(56)
verses.translation: (56) Lest a soul should say: O woe to me! for what I fell short of my duty to Allah, and most surely I was of those who laughed to scorn;

verses.arabic: اَوْ تَقُوْلَ لَوْ اَنَّ اللّٰهَ هَدٰٮنِىْ لَكُنْتُ مِنَ الْمُتَّقِيْنَۙ‏(57)
verses.translation: (57) Or it should say: Had Allah guided me, I would certainly have been of those who guard (against evil);

verses.arabic: اَوْ تَقُوْلَ حِيْنَ تَرَى الْعَذَابَ لَوْ اَنَّ لِىْ كَرَّةً فَاَكُوْنَ مِنَ الْمُحْسِنِيْنَ‏(58)
verses.translation: (58) Or it should say when it sees the punishment: Were there only a returning for me, I should be of the doers of good.

verses.arabic: بَلٰى قَدْ جَآءَتْكَ اٰيٰتِىْ فَكَذَّبْتَ بِهَا وَاسْتَكْبَرْتَ وَكُنْتَ مِنَ الْكٰفِرِيْنَ‏(59)
verses.translation: (59) Aye! My communications came to you, but you rejected them, and you were proud and you were one of the unbelievers.

verses.arabic: وَيَوْمَ الْقِيٰمَةِ تَرَى الَّذِيْنَ كَذَبُوْا عَلَى اللّٰهِ وُجُوْهُهُمْ مُّسْوَدَّةٌ ؕ اَلَيْسَ فِىْ جَهَنَّمَ مَثْوًى لِّلْمُتَكَبِّرِيْنَ‏(60)
verses.translation: (60) And on the day of resurrection you shall see those who lied against Allah; their faces shall be blackened. Is there not in hell an abode for the proud?

verses.arabic: وَيُنَجِّىْ اللّٰهُ الَّذِيْنَ اتَّقَوْا بِمَفَازَتِهِمْ لَا يَمَسُّهُمُ السُّوْٓءُ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُوْنَ‏(61)
verses.translation: (61) And Allah shall deliver those who guard (against evil) with their achievement; evil shall not touch them, nor shall they grieve.

verses.arabic: اَللّٰهُ خَالِقُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ‌ وَّ هُوَ عَلٰى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ وَّكِيْلٌ‏(62)
verses.translation: (62) Allah is the Creator of every thing and He has charge over every thing.

verses.arabic: لَّهٗ مَقَالِيْدُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِ‌ؕ وَ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا بِاٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِ اُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْخٰسِرُوْنَ‏(63)
verses.translation: (63) His are the treasures of the heavens and the earth; and (as for) those who disbelieve in the communications of Allah, these it is that are the losers.

verses.arabic: قُلْ اَفَغَيْرَ اللّٰهِ تَاْمُرُوْٓنِّىْۤ اَعْبُدُ اَيُّهَا الْجٰهِلُوْنَ‏(64)
verses.translation: (64) Say: What! Do you then bid me serve others than Allah, O ignorant men?

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ اُوْحِىَ اِلَيْكَ وَاِلَى الَّذِيْنَ مِنْ قَبْلِكَ‌ۚ لَئِنْ اَشْرَكْتَ لَيَحْبَطَنَّ عَمَلُكَ وَلَتَكُوْنَنَّ مِنَ الْخٰسِرِيْنَ‏(65)
verses.translation: (65) And certainly, it has been revealed to you and to those before you: Surely if you associate (with Allah), your work would certainly come to naught and you would certainly be of the losers.

verses.arabic: بَلِ اللّٰهَ فَاعْبُدْ وَكُنْ مِّنَ الشّٰكِرِيْنَ‏(66)
verses.translation: (66) Nay! but serve Allah alone and be of the thankful.

verses.arabic: وَمَا قَدَرُوْا اللّٰهَ حَقَّ قَدْرِهٖ ‌ۖ  وَالْاَرْضُ جَمِيْعًا قَبْضَتُهٗ يَوْمَ الْقِيٰمَةِ وَالسَّمٰوٰتُ مَطْوِيّٰتٌۢ بِيَمِيْنِهٖ‌ ؕ سُبْحٰنَهٗ وَتَعٰلٰى عَمَّا يُشْرِكُوْنَ‏(67)
verses.translation: (67) And they have not honored Allah with the honor that is due to Him; and the whole earth shall be in His grip on the day of resurrection and the heavens rolled up in His right hand; glory be to Him, and may He be exalted above what they associate (with Him).

verses.arabic: وَنُفِخَ فِى الصُّوْرِ فَصَعِقَ مَنْ فِى السَّمٰوٰتِ وَمَنْ فِى الْاَرْضِ اِلَّا مَنْ شَآءَ اللّٰهُ‌ ؕ ثُمَّ نُفِخَ فِيْهِ اُخْرٰى فَاِذَا هُمْ قِيَامٌ يَّنْظُرُوْنَ‏(68)
verses.translation: (68) And the trumpet shall be blown, so all those that are in the heavens and all those that are in the earth shall swoon, except such as Allah please; then it shall be blown again, then lo! they shall stand up awaiting.

verses.arabic: وَاَشْرَقَتِ الْاَرْضُ بِنُوْرِ رَبِّهَا وَوُضِعَ الْكِتٰبُ وَجِآىْ ئَ بِالنَّبِيّٖنَ وَالشُّهَدَآءِ وَقُضِىَ بَيْنَهُمْ بِالْحَقِّ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُوْنَ‏(69)
verses.translation: (69) And the earth shall beam with the light of its Lord, and the Book shall be laid down, and the prophets and the witnesses shall be brought up, and Judgement shall be given between them with justice, and they shall not be dealt with unjustly.

verses.arabic: وَوُفِّيَتْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَّا عَمِلَتْ وَهُوَ اَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَفْعَلُوْنَ‏(70)
verses.translation: (70) And every soul shall be paid back fully what it has done, and He knows best what they do.

verses.arabic: وَسِيْقَ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْۤا اِلٰى جَهَنَّمَ زُمَرًا‌ ؕ حَتّٰٓى اِذَا جَآءُوْهَا فُتِحَتْ اَبْوَابُهَا وَقَالَ لَهُمْ خَزَنَتُهَاۤ اَلَمْ يَاْتِكُمْ رُسُلٌ مِّنْكُمْ يَتْلُوْنَ عَلَيْكُمْ اٰيٰتِ رَبِّكُمْ وَيُنْذِرُوْنَكُمْ لِقَآءَ يَوْمِكُمْ هٰذَا‌ ؕ قَالُوْا بَلٰى وَلٰكِنْ حَقَّتْ كَلِمَةُ الْعَذَابِ عَلَى الْكٰفِرِيْنَ‏(71)
verses.translation: (71) And those who disbelieve shall be driven to hell in companies; until, when they come to it, its doors shall be opened, and the keepers of it shall say to them: Did not there come to you apostles from among you reciting to you the communications of your Lord and warning you of the meeting of this day of yours? They shall say: Yea! But the sentence of punishment was due against the unbelievers.

verses.arabic: قِيْلَ ادْخُلُوْۤا اَبْوَابَ جَهَنَّمَ خٰلِدِيْنَ فِيْهَا‌ۚ فَبِئْسَ مَثْوَى الْمُتَكَبِّرِيْنَ‏(72)
verses.translation: (72) It shall be said: Enter the gates of hell to abide therein; so evil is the abode of the proud.

verses.arabic: وَسِيْقَ الَّذِيْنَ اتَّقَوْا رَبَّهُمْ اِلَى الْجَنَّةِ زُمَرًا‌ؕ حَتّٰٓى اِذَا جَآءُوْهَا وَفُتِحَتْ اَبْوَابُهَا وَقَالَ لَهُمْ خَزَنَتُهَا سَلٰمٌ عَلَيْكُمْ طِبْتُمْ فَادْخُلُوْهَا خٰلِدِيْنَ‏(73)
verses.translation: (73) And those who are careful of (their duty to) their Lord shall be conveyed to the garden in companies; until when they come to it, and its doors shall be opened, and the keepers of it shall say to them: Peace be on you, you shall be happy; therefore enter it to abide.

verses.arabic: وَقَالُوا الْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِىْ صَدَقَنَا وَعْدَهٗ وَاَوْرَثَنَا الْاَرْضَ نَتَبَوَّاُ مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ حَيْثُ نَشَآءُ ‌ۚ فَنِعْمَ اَجْرُ الْعٰمِلِيْنَ‏(74)
verses.translation: (74) And they shall say: (All) praise is due to Allah, Who has made good to us His promise, and He has made us inherit the land; we may abide in the garden where we please; so goodly is the reward of the workers.

verses.arabic: وَتَرَى الْمَلٰٓئِكَةَ حَآفِّيْنَ مِنْ حَوْلِ الْعَرْشِ يُسَبِّحُوْنَ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّهِمْ‌ۚ وَقُضِىَ بَيْنَهُمْ بِالْحَقِّ وَقِيْلَ الْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ رَبِّ الْعٰلَمِيْنَ‏(75)
verses.translation: (75) And you shall see the angels going round about the throne glorifying the praise of their Lord; and Judgement shall be given between them with justice, and it shall be said: All praise is due to Allah, the Lord of the worlds.

verses.arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِيْمِ

verses.translation: (1) Ha Mim.

verses.arabic: تَنْزِيْلُ الْكِتٰبِ مِنَ اللّٰهِ الْعَزِيْزِ الْعَلِيْمِۙ‏(2)
verses.translation: (2) The revelation of the Book is from Allah, the Mighty, the Knowing,

verses.arabic: غَافِرِ الذَّنْۢبِ وَقَابِلِ التَّوْبِ شَدِيْدِ الْعِقَابِ ذِى الطَّوْلِؕ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَؕ اِلَيْهِ الْمَصِيْرُ‏(3)
verses.translation: (3) The Forgiver of the faults and the Acceptor of repentance, Severe to punish, Lord of bounty; there is no god but He; to Him is the eventual coming.

verses.arabic: مَا يُجَادِلُ فِىْۤ اٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِ اِلَّا الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا فَلَا يَغْرُرْكَ تَقَلُّبُهُمْ فِى الْبِلَادِ‏(4)
verses.translation: (4) None dispute concerning the communications of Allah but those who disbelieve, therefore let not their going to and fro in the cities deceive you.

verses.arabic: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوْحٍ وَّ الْاَحْزَابُ مِنْۢ بَعْدِهِمْ وَهَمَّتْ كُلُّ اُمَّةٍۢ بِرَسُوْلِهِمْ لِيَاْخُذُوْهُ ؕ وَجَادَلُوْا بِالْبَاطِلِ لِيُدْحِضُوْا بِهِ الْحَقَّ فَاَخَذْتُهُمْ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عِقَابِ‏(5)
verses.translation: (5) The people of Nuh and the parties after them rejected (prophets) before them, and every nation purposed against their apostle to destroy him, and they disputed by means of the falsehood that they might thereby render null the truth, therefore I destroyed them; how was then My retribution!

verses.arabic: وَكَذٰلِكَ حَقَّتْ كَلِمَتُ رَبِّكَ عَلَى الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْۤا اَنَّهُمْ اَصْحٰبُ النَّارِ ؔ‌ۘ‏(6)
verses.translation: (6) And thus did the word of your Lord prove true against those who disbelieved that they are the inmates of the fire.

verses.arabic: اَلَّذِيْنَ يَحْمِلُوْنَ الْعَرْشَ وَمَنْ حَوْلَهٗ يُسَبِّحُوْنَ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّهِمْ وَيُؤْمِنُوْنَ بِهٖ وَيَسْتَغْفِرُوْنَ لِلَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا‌ ۚ رَبَّنَا وَسِعْتَ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ رَّحْمَةً وَّعِلْمًا فَاغْفِرْ لِلَّذِيْنَ تَابُوْا وَاتَّبَعُوْا سَبِيْلَكَ وَقِهِمْ عَذَابَ الْجَحِيْمِ‏(7)
verses.translation: (7) Those who bear the power and those around Him celebrate the praise of their Lord and believe in Him and ask protection for those who believe: Our Lord! Thou embracest all things in mercy and knowledge, therefore grant protection to those who turn (to Thee) and follow Thy way, and save them from the punishment of the hell:

verses.arabic: رَبَّنَا وَاَدْخِلْهُمْ جَنّٰتِ عَدْنِ ۟الَّتِىْ وَعَدْتَّهُمْ وَمَنْ صَلَحَ مِنْ اٰبَآئِهِمْ وَاَزْوَاجِهِمْ وَذُرِّيّٰتِهِمْ ؕ اِنَّكَ اَنْتَ الْعَزِيْزُ الْحَكِيْمُ ۙ‏(8)
verses.translation: (8) Our Lord! and make them enter the gardens of perpetuity which Thou hast promised to them and those who do good of their fathers and their wives and their offspring, surely Thou are the Mighty, the Wise.

verses.arabic: وَقِهِمُ السَّيِّاٰتِ ؕ وَمَنْ تَقِ السَّيِّاٰتِ يَوْمَئِذٍ فَقَدْ رَحِمْتَهٗ ؕ وَذٰ لِكَ هُوَ الْفَوْزُ الْعَظِيْمُ‏(9)
verses.translation: (9) And keep them from evil deeds, and whom Thou keepest from evil deeds this day, indeed Thou hast mercy on him, and that is the mighty achievement.

verses.arabic: اِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا يُنَادَوْنَ لَمَقْتُ اللّٰهِ اَكْبَرُ مِنْ مَّقْتِكُمْ اَنْفُسَكُمْ اِذْ تُدْعَوْنَ اِلَى الْاِيْمَانِ فَتَكْفُرُوْنَ‏(10)
verses.translation: (10) Surely those who disbelieve shall be cried out to: Certainly Allah's hatred (of you) when you were called upon to the faith and you rejected, is much greater than your hatred of yourselves.

verses.arabic: قَالُوْا رَبَّنَاۤ اَمَتَّنَا اثْنَتَيْنِ وَاَحْيَيْتَنَا اثْنَتَيْنِ فَاعْتَرَفْنَا بِذُنُوْبِنَا فَهَلْ اِلٰى خُرُوْجٍ مِّنْ سَبِيْلٍ‏(11)
verses.translation: (11) They shall say: Our Lord! twice didst Thou make us subject to death, and twice hast Thou given us life, so we do confess our faults; is there then a way to get out?

verses.arabic: ذٰ لِكُمْ بِاَنَّهٗۤ اِذَا دُعِىَ اللّٰهُ وَحْدَهٗ كَفَرْتُمْ ۚ وَاِنْ يُّشْرَكْ بِهٖ تُؤْمِنُوْا ؕ فَالْحُكْمُ لِلّٰهِ الْعَلِىِّ الْكَبِيْرِ‏(12)
verses.translation: (12) That is because when Allah alone was called upon, you disbelieved, and when associates were given to Him, you believed; so Judgement belongs to Allah, the High, the Great.

verses.arabic: هُوَ الَّذِىْ يُرِيْكُمْ اٰيٰتِهٖ وَيُنَزِّلُ لَكُمْ مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ رِزْقًا ؕ وَمَا يَتَذَكَّرُ اِلَّا مَنْ يُّنِيْبُ‏(13)
verses.translation: (13) He it is Who shows you His signs and sends down for you sustenance from heaven, and none minds but he who turns (to Him) again and again.

verses.arabic: فَادْعُوا اللّٰهَ مُخْلِصِيْنَ لَهُ الدِّيْنَ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ الْكٰفِرُوْنَ‏(14)
verses.translation: (14) Therefore call upon Allah, being sincere to Him in obedience, though the unbelievers are averse:

verses.arabic: رَفِيْعُ الدَّرَجٰتِ ذُو الْعَرْشِ‌ ۚ يُلْقِى الرُّوْحَ مِنْ اَمْرِهٖ عَلٰى مَنْ يَّشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهٖ لِيُنْذِرَ يَوْمَ التَّلَاقِ ۙ‏(15)
verses.translation: (15) Possessor of the highest rank, Lord of power: He makes the inspiration to light by His command upon whom He pleases of His servants, that he may warn (men) of the day of meeting.

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ هُمْ بَارِزُوْنَ ۚ لَا يَخْفٰى عَلَى اللّٰهِ مِنْهُمْ شَىْءٌ ؕ لِمَنِ الْمُلْكُ الْيَوْمَ ؕ لِلّٰهِ الْوَاحِدِ الْقَهَّارِ‏(16)
verses.translation: (16) (Of) the day when they shall come forth, nothing concerning them remains hidden to Allah. To whom belongs the kingdom this day? To Allah, the One, the Subduer (of all).

verses.arabic: اَ لْيَوْمَ تُجْزٰى كُلُّ نَفْسٍۢ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ ؕ لَا ظُلْمَ الْيَوْمَ ؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ سَرِيْعُ الْحِسَابِ‏(17)
verses.translation: (17) This day every soul shall be rewarded for what it has earned; no injustice (shall be done) this day; surely Allah is quick in reckoning.

verses.arabic: وَاَنْذِرْهُمْ يَوْمَ الْاٰزِفَةِ اِذِ الْقُلُوْبُ لَدَى الْحَنَاجِرِ كٰظِمِيْنَ ؕ مَا لِلظّٰلِمِيْنَ مِنْ حَمِيْمٍ وَّلَا شَفِيْعٍ يُّطَاعُ ؕ‏(18)
verses.translation: (18) And warn them of the day that draws near, when hearts shall rise up to the throats, grieving inwardly; the unjust shall not have any compassionate friend nor any intercessor who should be obeyed.

verses.arabic: يَعْلَمُ خَآئِنَةَ الْاَعْيُنِ وَمَا تُخْفِى الصُّدُوْرُ‏(19)
verses.translation: (19) He knows the stealthy looks and that which the breasts conceal.

verses.arabic: وَاللّٰهُ يَقْضِىْ بِالْحَقِّؕ وَالَّذِيْنَ يَدْعُوْنَ مِنْ دُوْنِهٖ لَا يَقْضُوْنَ بِشَىْءٍؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ هُوَ السَّمِيْعُ الْبَصِيْرُ‏(20)
verses.translation: (20) And Allah judges with the truth; and those whom they call upon besides Him cannot judge aught; surely Allah is the Hearing, the Seeing.

verses.arabic: اَوَلَمْ يَسِيْرُوْا فِى الْاَرْضِ فَيَنْظُرُوْا كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الَّذِيْنَ كَانُوْا مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْؕ كَانُوْا هُمْ اَشَدَّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةً وَّاٰثَارًا فِى الْاَرْضِ فَاَخَذَهُمُ اللّٰهُ بِذُنُوْبِهِمْؕ وَمَا كَانَ لَهُمْ مِّنَ اللّٰهِ مِنْ وَّاقٍ‏(21)
verses.translation: (21) Have they not travelled in the earth and seen how was the end of those who were before them? Mightier than these were they in strength-- and in fortifications in the land, but Allah destroyed them for their sins; and there was not for them any defender against Allah.

verses.arabic: ذٰلِكَ بِاَنَّهُمْ كَانَتْ تَّاْتِيْهِمْ رُسُلُهُمْ بِالْبَيِّنٰتِ فَكَفَرُوْا فَاَخَذَهُمُ اللّٰهُؕ اِنَّهٗ قَوِىٌّ شَدِيْدُ الْعِقَابِ‏(22)
verses.translation: (22) That was because there came to them their apostles with clear arguments, but they rejected (them), therefore Allah destroyed them; surely He is Strong, Severe in retribution.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ اَرْسَلْنَا مُوْسٰى بِاٰيٰتِنَا وَسُلْطٰنٍ مُّبِيْنٍۙ‏(23)
verses.translation: (23) And certainly We sent Musa with Our communications and clear authority,

verses.arabic: اِلٰى فِرْعَوْنَ وَ هَامٰنَ وَقَارُوْنَ فَقَالُوْا سٰحِرٌ كَذَّابٌ‏(24)
verses.translation: (24) To Firon and Haman and Qaroun, but they said: A lying magician.

verses.arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ بِالْحَقِّ مِنْ عِنْدِنَا قَالُوْا اقْتُلُوْۤا اَبْنَآءَ الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا مَعَهٗ وَاسْتَحْيُوْا نِسَآءَهُمْؕ وَمَا كَيْدُ الْكٰفِرِيْنَ اِلَّا فِىْ ضَلٰلٍ‏(25)
verses.translation: (25) So when he brought to them the truth from Us, they said: Slay the sons of those who believe with him and keep their women alive; and the struggle of the unbelievers will only come to a state of perdition.

verses.arabic: وَقَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ ذَرُوْنِىْۤ اَقْتُلْ مُوْسٰى وَلْيَدْعُ رَبَّهٗ‌ۚ اِنِّىْۤ اَخَافُ اَنْ يُّبَدِّلَ دِيْنَكُمْ اَوْ اَنْ يُّظْهِرَ فِى الْاَرْضِ الْفَسَادَ‏(26)
verses.translation: (26) And Firon said: Let me alone that I may slay Musa and let him call upon his Lord; surely I fear that he will change your religion or that he will make mischief to appear in the land.

verses.arabic: وَقَالَ مُوْسٰٓى اِنِّىْ عُذْتُ بِرَبِّىْ وَرَبِّكُمْ مِّنْ كُلِّ مُتَكَبِّرٍ لَّا يُؤْمِنُ بِيَوْمِ الْحِسَابِ‏(27)
verses.translation: (27) And Musa said: Surely I take refuge with my Lord and-- your Lord from every proud one who does not believe in the day of reckoning.

verses.arabic: وَقَالَ رَجُلٌ مُّؤْمِنٌ ‌ۖ مِّنْ اٰلِ فِرْعَوْنَ يَكْتُمُ اِيْمَانَهٗۤ اَتَقْتُلُوْنَ رَجُلًا اَنْ يَّقُوْلَ رَبِّىَ اللّٰهُ وَقَدْ جَآءَكُمْ بِالْبَيِّنٰتِ مِنْ رَّبِّكُمْ ؕ وَاِنْ يَّكُ كَاذِبًا فَعَلَيْهِ كَذِبُهٗ ؕ وَاِنْ يَّكُ صَادِقًا يُّصِبْكُمْ بَعْضُ الَّذِىْ يَعِدُكُمْ ۚ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا يَهْدِىْ مَنْ هُوَ مُسْرِفٌ كَذَّابٌ‏(28)
verses.translation: (28) And a believing man of Firon's people who hid his faith said: What! will you slay a man because he says: My Lord is Allah, and indeed he has brought to you clear arguments from your Lord? And if he be a liar, on him will be his lie, and if he be truthful, there will befall you some of that which he threatens you (with); surely Allah does not guide him who is extravagant, a liar:

verses.arabic: يٰقَوْمِ لَكُمُ الْمُلْكُ الْيَوْمَ ظٰهِرِيْنَ فِى الْاَرْضِ فَمَنْ يَّنْصُرُنَا مِنْۢ بَاْسِ اللّٰهِ اِنْ جَآءَنَا ؕ قَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ مَاۤ اُرِيْكُمْ اِلَّا مَاۤ اَرٰى وَمَاۤ اَهْدِيْكُمْ اِلَّا سَبِيْلَ الرَّشَادِ‏(29)
verses.translation: (29) O my people! yours is the kingdom this day, being masters in the land, but who will help us against the punishment of Allah if it come to us? Firon said: I do not show you aught but that which I see (myself), and I do not make you follow any but the right way.

verses.arabic: وَقَالَ الَّذِىْۤ اٰمَنَ يٰقَوْمِ اِنِّىْۤ اَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ مِّثْلَ يَوْمِ الْاَحْزَابِۙ‏(30)
verses.translation: (30) And he who believed said: O my people! surely I fear for you the like of what befell the parties:

verses.arabic: مِثْلَ دَاْبِ قَوْمِ نُوْحٍ وَّعَادٍ وَّثَمُوْدَ وَالَّذِيْنَ مِنْۢ بَعْدِهِمْؕ وَمَا اللّٰهُ يُرِيْدُ ظُلْمًا لِّلْعِبَادِ‏(31)
verses.translation: (31) The like of what befell the people of Nuh and Ad and Samood and those after them, and Allah does not desire injustice for (His) servants;

verses.arabic: وَيٰقَوْمِ اِنِّىْۤ اَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ يَوْمَ التَّنَادِۙ‏(32)
verses.translation: (32) And, O my people! I fear for you the day of calling out,

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ تُوَلُّوْنَ مُدْبِرِيْنَ‌ۚ مَا لَكُمْ مِّنَ اللّٰهِ مِنْ عَاصِمٍۚ وَمَنْ يُّضْلِلِ اللّٰهُ فَمَا لَهٗ مِنْ هَادٍ‏(33)
verses.translation: (33) The day on which you will turn back retreating; there shall be no savior for you from Allah, and whomsoever Allah causes to err, there is no guide for him:

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَكُمْ يُوْسُفُ مِنْ قَبْلُ بِالْبَيِّنٰتِ فَمَا زِلْتُمْ فِىْ شَكٍّ مِّمَّا جَآءَكُمْ بِهٖ ؕ حَتّٰٓى اِذَا هَلَكَ قُلْتُمْ لَنْ يَّبْعَثَ اللّٰهُ مِنْۢ بَعْدِهٖ رَسُوْلًا ؕ كَذٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ اللّٰهُ مَنْ هُوَ مُسْرِفٌ مُّرْتَابٌ  ۚ ۖ‏(34)
verses.translation: (34) And certainly Yusuf came to you before with clear arguments, but you ever remained in doubt as to what he brought; until when he died, you said: Allah will never raise an apostle after him. Thus does Allah cause him to err who is extravagant, a doubter

verses.arabic: ۟الَّذِيْنَ يُجَادِلُوْنَ فِىْۤ اٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِ بِغَيْرِ سُلْطٰنٍ اَتٰٮهُمْ ؕ كَبُرَ مَقْتًا عِنْدَ اللّٰهِ وَعِنْدَ الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا ؕ كَذٰلِكَ يَطْبَعُ اللّٰهُ عَلٰى كُلِّ قَلْبِ مُتَكَبِّرٍ جَبَّارٍ‏(35)
verses.translation: (35) Those who dispute concerning the communications of Allah without any authority that He has given them; greatly hated is it by Allah and by-those who believe. Thus does Allah set a seal over the heart of every proud, haughty one.

verses.arabic: وَقَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ يٰهَامٰنُ ابْنِ لِىْ صَرْحًا لَّعَلِّىْۤ اَبْلُغُ الْاَسْبَابَۙ‏(36)
verses.translation: (36) And Firon said: O Haman! build for me a tower that I may attain the means of access,

verses.arabic: اَسْبَابَ السَّمٰوٰتِ فَاَطَّلِعَ اِلٰٓى اِلٰهِ مُوْسٰى وَاِنِّىْ لَاَظُنُّهٗ كَاذِبًا ؕ وَكَذٰلِكَ زُيِّنَ لِفِرْعَوْنَ سُوْٓءُ عَمَلِهٖ وَصُدَّ عَنِ السَّبِيْلِ ؕ وَمَا كَيْدُ فِرْعَوْنَ اِلَّا فِىْ تَبَابٍ‏(37)
verses.translation: (37) The means of access to the heavens, then reach the god of Musa, and I surely think him to be a liar. And thus the evil of his deed was made fairseeming to Firon, and he was turned away from the way; and the struggle of Firon was not (to end) in aught but destruction.

verses.arabic: وَقَالَ الَّذِىْۤ اٰمَنَ يٰقَوْمِ اتَّبِعُوْنِ اَهْدِكُمْ سَبِيْلَ الرَّشَادِ‌ۚ‏(38)
verses.translation: (38) And he who believed said: O my people! follow me, I will guide you to the right course;

verses.arabic: يٰقَوْمِ اِنَّمَا هٰذِهِ الْحَيٰوةُ الدُّنْيَا مَتَاعٌ وَّاِنَّ الْاٰخِرَةَ هِىَ دَارُ الْقَرَارِ‏(39)
verses.translation: (39) O my people! this life of the world is only a (passing) enjoyment, and surely the hereafter is the abode to settle;

verses.arabic: مَنْ عَمِلَ سَيِّئَةً فَلَا يُجْزٰٓى اِلَّا مِثْلَهَا ۚ وَمَنْ عَمِلَ صَالِحًا مِّنْ ذَكَرٍ اَوْ اُنْثٰى وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ فَاُولٰٓئِكَ يَدْخُلُوْنَ الْجَنَّةَ يُرْزَقُوْنَ فِيْهَا بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ‏(40)
verses.translation: (40) Whoever does an evil, he shall not be recompensed (with aught) but the like of it, and whoever does good, whether male or female, and he is a believer, these shall enter the garden, in which they shall be given sustenance without measure.

verses.arabic: وَيٰقَوْمِ مَا لِىْۤ اَدْعُوْكُمْ اِلَى النَّجٰوةِ وَتَدْعُوْنَنِىْۤ اِلَى النَّارِؕ‏(41)
verses.translation: (41) And, O my people! how is it that I call you to salvation and you call me to the fire?

verses.arabic: تَدْعُوْنَنِىْ لِاَكْفُرَ بِاللّٰهِ وَاُشْرِكَ بِهٖ مَا لَيْسَ لِىْ بِهٖ عِلْمٌ وَّاَنَا اَدْعُوْكُمْ اِلَى الْعَزِيْزِ الْغَفَّارِ‏(42)
verses.translation: (42) You call on me that I should disbelieve in Allah and associate with Him that of which I have no knowledge, and I call you to the Mighty, the most Forgiving;

verses.arabic: لَا جَرَمَ اَنَّمَا تَدْعُوْنَنِىْۤ اِلَيْهِ لَيْسَ لَهٗ دَعْوَةٌ فِى الدُّنْيَا وَلَا فِى الْاٰخِرَةِ وَاَنَّ مَرَدَّنَاۤ اِلَى اللّٰهِ وَاَنَّ الْمُسْرِفِيْنَ هُمْ اَصْحٰبُ النَّارِ‏(43)
verses.translation: (43) No doubt that what you call me to has no title to be called to in this world, nor in the hereafter, and that our turning back is to Allah, and that the extravagant are the inmates of the fire;

verses.arabic: فَسَتَذْكُرُوْنَ مَاۤ اَقُوْلُ لَكُمْؕ وَاُفَوِّضُ اَمْرِىْۤ اِلَى اللّٰهِؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ بَصِيْرٌۢ بِالْعِبَادِ‏(44)
verses.translation: (44) So you shall remember what I say to you, and I entrust my affair to Allah, Surely Allah sees the servants.

verses.arabic: فَوَقٰٮهُ اللّٰهُ سَيِّاٰتِ مَا مَكَرُوْا وَحَاقَ بِاٰلِ فِرْعَوْنَ سُوْٓءُ الْعَذَابِ‌ۚ‏(45)
verses.translation: (45) So Allah protected him from the evil (consequences) of what they planned, and the most evil punishment overtook Firon's people:

verses.arabic: اَلنَّارُ يُعْرَضُوْنَ عَلَيْهَا غُدُوًّا وَّعَشِيًّا ۚ وَيَوْمَ تَقُوْمُ السَّاعَةُ اَدْخِلُوْۤا اٰلَ فِرْعَوْنَ اَشَدَّ الْعَذَابِ‏(46)
verses.translation: (46) The fire; they shall be brought before it (every) morning and evening and on the day when the hour shall come to pass: Make Firon's people enter the severest chastisement.

verses.arabic: وَاِذْ يَتَحَآجُّوْنَ فِى النَّارِ فَيَقُوْلُ الضُّعَفٰٓؤُا لِلَّذِيْنَ اسْتَكْبَرُوْۤا اِنَّا كُنَّا لَكُمْ تَبَعًا فَهَلْ اَنْتُمْ مُّغْنُوْنَ عَنَّا نَصِيْبًا مِّنَ النَّارِ‏(47)
verses.translation: (47) And when they shall contend one with another in the fire, then the weak shall say to those who were proud: Surely we were your followers; will you then avert from us a portion of the fire?

verses.arabic: قَالَ الَّذِيْنَ اسْتَكْبَرُوْۤا اِنَّا كُلٌّ فِيْهَاۤۙاِنَّ اللّٰهَ قَدْ حَكَمَ بَيْنَ الْعِبَادِ‏(48)
verses.translation: (48) Those who were proud shall say: Surely we are all in it: surely Allah has judged between the servants.

verses.arabic: وَقَالَ الَّذِيْنَ فِى النَّارِ لِخَزَنَةِ جَهَنَّمَ ادْعُوْا رَبَّكُمْ يُخَفِّفْ عَنَّا يَوْمًا مِّنَ الْعَذَابِ‏(49)
verses.translation: (49) And those who are in the fire shall say to the keepers of hell: Call upon your Lord that He may lighten to us one day of the punishment.

verses.arabic: قَالُوْۤا اَوَلَمْ تَكُ تَاْتِيْكُمْ رُسُلُكُمْ بِالْبَيِّنٰتِ ؕ قَالُوْا بَلٰى ؕ قَالُوْا‌ فَادْعُوْا ۚ وَمَا دُعٰٓؤُا الْكٰفِرِيْنَ اِلَّا فِىْ ضَلٰلٍ‏(50)
verses.translation: (50) They shall say: Did not your apostles come to you with clear arguments? They shall say: Yea. They shall say: Then call. And the call of the unbelievers is only in error.

verses.arabic: اِنَّا لَنَنْصُرُ رُسُلَنَا وَالَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا فِى الْحَيٰوةِ الدُّنْيَا وَيَوْمَ يَقُوْمُ الْاَشْهَادُ ۙ‏(51)
verses.translation: (51) Most surely We help Our apostles, and those who believe, in this world's life and on the day when the witnesses shall stand

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ لَا يَنْفَعُ الظّٰلِمِيْنَ مَعْذِرَتُهُمْ وَلَهُمُ اللَّعْنَةُ وَلَهُمْ سُوْٓءُ الدَّارِ‏(52)
verses.translation: (52) The day on which their excuse shall not benefit the unjust, and for them is curse and for them is the evil abode.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ اٰتَيْنَا مُوْسَى الْهُدٰى وَاَوْرَثْنَا بَنِىْۤ اِسْرَآءِيْلَ الْكِتٰبَۙ‏(53)
verses.translation: (53) And certainly We gave Musa the guidance, and We made the children of Israel inherit the Book,

verses.arabic: هُدًى وَّذِكْرٰى لِاُولِى الْاَلْبَابِ‏(54)
verses.translation: (54) A guidance and a reminder to the men of understanding.

verses.arabic: فَاصْبِرْ اِنَّ وَعْدَ اللّٰهِ حَقٌّ وَّاسْتَغْفِرْ لِذَنْۢبِكَ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ بِالْعَشِىِّ وَالْاِبْكَارِ‏(55)
verses.translation: (55) Therefore be patient; surely the promise of Allah is true; and ask protection for your fault and sing the praise of your Lord in the evening and the morning.

verses.arabic: اِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ يُجَادِلُوْنَ فِىْۤ اٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِ بِغَيْرِ سُلْطٰنٍ اَتٰٮهُمْۙ اِنْ فِىْ صُدُوْرِهِمْ اِلَّا كِبْرٌ مَّا هُمْ بِبَالِغِيْهِؕ فَاسْتَعِذْ بِاللّٰهِؕ اِنَّهٗ هُوَ السَّمِيْعُ الْبَصِيْرُ‏(56)
verses.translation: (56) Surely (as for) those who dispute about the communications of Allah without any authority that has come to them, there is naught in their breasts but (a desire) to become great which they shall never attain to; Therefore seek refuge in Allah, surely He is the Hearing, the Seeing.

verses.arabic: لَخَلْقُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِ اَكْبَرُ مِنْ خَلْقِ النَّاسِ وَلٰكِنَّ اَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُوْنَ‏(57)
verses.translation: (57) Certainly the creation of the heavens and the earth is greater than the creation of the men, but most people do not know

verses.arabic: وَمَا يَسْتَوِى الْاَعْمٰى وَالْبَصِيْرُ ۙ وَالَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَ عَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ وَلَا الْمُسِىْٓءُ ؕ قَلِيْلًا مَّا تَتَذَكَّرُوْنَ‏(58)
verses.translation: (58) And the blind and the seeing are not alike, nor those who believe and do good and the evil-doer; little is it that you are mindful.

verses.arabic: اِنَّ السَّاعَةَ لَاٰتِيَةٌ لَّا رَيْبَ فِيْهَا وَلٰكِنَّ اَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يُؤْمِنُوْنَ‏(59)
verses.translation: (59) Most surely the hour is coming, there is no doubt therein, but most people do not believe.

verses.arabic: وَقَالَ رَبُّكُمُ ادْعُوْنِىْۤ اَسْتَجِبْ لَكُمْؕ اِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ يَسْتَكْبِرُوْنَ عَنْ عِبَادَتِىْ سَيَدْخُلُوْنَ جَهَنَّمَ دَاخِرِيْنَ‏(60)
verses.translation: (60) And your Lord says: Call upon Me, I will answer you; surely those who are too proud for My service shall soon enter hell abased.

verses.arabic: اَللّٰهُ الَّذِىْ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الَّيْلَ لِتَسْكُنُوْا فِيْهِ وَالنَّهَارَ مُبْصِرًا ؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَذُوْ فَضْلٍ عَلَى النَّاسِ وَ لٰكِنَّ اَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَشْكُرُوْنَ‏(61)
verses.translation: (61) Allah is He Who made for you the night that you may rest therein and the day to see; most surely Allah is Gracious to men, but most men do not give thanks.

verses.arabic: ذٰ لِكُمُ اللّٰهُ رَبُّكُمْ خَالِقُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ‌ ۘ لَّاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ ‌ۚ  فَاَ نّٰى تُؤْفَكُوْنَ‏(62)
verses.translation: (62) That is Allah, your Lord, the Creator of everything; there is no Allah but He; whence are you then turned away?

verses.arabic: كَذٰلِكَ يُؤْفَكُ الَّذِيْنَ كَانُوْا بِاٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِ يَجْحَدُوْنَ‏(63)
verses.translation: (63) Thus were turned away those who denied the communications of Allah.

verses.arabic: اَللّٰهُ الَّذِىْ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الْاَرْضَ قَرَارًا وَّالسَّمَآءَ بِنَآءً وَّصَوَّرَكُمْ فَاَحْسَنَ صُوَرَكُمْ وَرَزَقَكُمْ مِّنَ الطَّيِّبٰتِ ؕ ذٰ لِكُمُ اللّٰهُ رَبُّكُمْ ‌ ۖۚ فَتَبٰرَكَ اللّٰهُ رَبُّ الْعٰلَمِيْنَ‏(64)
verses.translation: (64) Allah is He Who made the earth a resting-place for you and the heaven a canopy, and He formed you, then made goodly your forms, and He provided you with goodly things; that is Allah, your Lord; blessed then is Allah, the Lord of the worlds.

verses.arabic: هُوَ الْحَىُّ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ فَادْعُوْهُ مُخْلِصِيْنَ لَهُ الدِّيْنَؕ اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ رَبِّ الْعٰلَمِيْنَ‏(65)
verses.translation: (65) He is the Living, there is no god but He, therefore call on Him, being sincere to Him in obedience; (all) praise is due to Allah, the Lord of the worlds.

verses.arabic: قُلْ اِنِّىْ نُهِيْتُ اَنْ اَعْبُدَ الَّذِيْنَ تَدْعُوْنَ مِنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ لَمَّا جَآءَنِىَ الْبَيِّنٰتُ مِنْ رَّبِّىْ وَاُمِرْتُ اَنْ اُسْلِمَ لِرَبِّ الْعٰلَمِيْنَ‏(66)
verses.translation: (66) Say: I am forbidden to serve those whom you call upon besides Allah when clear arguments have come to me from my Lord, and I am commanded that I should submit to the Lord of the worlds.

verses.arabic: هُوَ الَّذِىْ خَلَقَكُمْ مِّنْ تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ مِنْ نُّطْفَةٍ ثُمَّ مِنْ عَلَقَةٍ ثُمَّ يُخْرِجُكُمْ طِفْلًا ثُمَّ لِتَبْلُغُوْۤا اَشُدَّكُمْ ثُمَّ لِتَكُوْنُوْا شُيُوْخًا ؕ وَمِنْكُمْ مَّنْ يُّتَوَفّٰى مِنْ قَبْلُ وَلِتَبْلُغُوْۤا اَجَلًا مُّسَمًّى وَّلَعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُوْنَ‏(67)
verses.translation: (67) He it is Who created you from dust, then from a small lifegerm, then from a clot, then He brings you forth as a child, then that you may attain your maturity, then that you may be old-- and of you there are some who are caused to die before-- and that you may reach an appointed term, and that you may understand.

verses.arabic: هُوَ الَّذِىْ يُحْىٖ وَيُمِيْتُؕ فَاِذَا قَضٰٓى اَمْرًا فَاِنَّمَا يَقُوْلُ لَهٗ كُنْ فَيَكُوْنُ‏(68)
verses.translation: (68) He it is Who gives life and brings death, so when He decrees an affair, He only says to it: Be, and it is.

verses.arabic: اَلَمْ تَرَ اِلَى الَّذِيْنَ يُجَادِلُوْنَ فِىْۤ اٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِؕ اَنّٰى يُصْرَفُوْنَ  ۛۚ ۙ‏(69)
verses.translation: (69) Have you not seen those who dispute with respect to the communications of Allah: how are they turned away?

verses.arabic: الَّذِيْنَ كَذَّبُوْا بِالْكِتٰبِ وَبِمَاۤ اَرْسَلْنَا بِهٖ رُسُلَنَا ۛ  فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُوْنَ ۙ‏(70)
verses.translation: (70) Those who reject the Book and that with which We have sent Our Apostle; but they shall soon come to know,

verses.arabic: اِذِ الْاَغْلٰلُ فِىْۤ اَعْنَاقِهِمْ وَالسَّلٰسِلُؕ يُسْحَبُوْنَۙ‏(71)
verses.translation: (71) When the fetters and the chains shall be on their necks; they shall be dragged

verses.arabic: فِى الْحَمِيْمِ ۙ ثُمَّ فِى النَّارِ يُسْجَرُوْنَ‌ ۚ‏(72)
verses.translation: (72) Into boiling water, then in the fire shall they be burned;

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ قِيْلَ لَهُمْ اَيْنَ مَا كُنْتُمْ تُشْرِكُوْنَۙ‏(73)
verses.translation: (73) Then shall it be said to them: Where is that which you used to set up

verses.arabic: مِنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ ؕ قَالُوْا ضَلُّوْا عَنَّا بَلْ لَّمْ نَكُنْ نَّدْعُوْا مِنْ قَبْلُ شَيْئًا ؕ كَذٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ اللّٰهُ الْكٰفِرِيْنَ‏(74)
verses.translation: (74) Besides Allah? They shall say: They are gone away from us, nay, we used not to call upon anything before. Thus does Allah confound the unbelievers.

verses.arabic: ذٰ لِكُمْ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَفْرَحُوْنَ فِى الْاَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ الْحَقِّ وَبِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَمْرَحُوْنَ‌ ۚ‏(75)
verses.translation: (75) That is because you exulted in the land unjustly and because you behaved insolently.

verses.arabic: اُدْخُلُوْۤا اَبْوَابَ جَهَنَّمَ خٰلِدِيْنَ فِيْهَا ۚ فَبِئْسَ مَثْوَى الْمُتَكَبِّرِيْنَ‏(76)
verses.translation: (76) Enter the gates of hell to abide therein, evil then is the abode of the proud.

verses.arabic: فَاصْبِرْ اِنَّ وَعْدَ اللّٰهِ حَقٌّۚ فَاِمَّا نُرِيَنَّكَ بَعْضَ الَّذِىْ نَعِدُهُمْ اَوْ نَتَوَفَّيَنَّكَ فَاِلَيْنَا يُرْجَعُوْنَ‏(77)
verses.translation: (77) So be patient, surely the promise of Allah is true. So should We make you see part of what We threaten them with, or should We cause you to die, to Us shall they be returned.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ اَرْسَلْنَا رُسُلًا مِّنْ قَبْلِكَ مِنْهُمْ مَّنْ قَصَصْنَا عَلَيْكَ وَمِنْهُمْ مَّنْ لَّمْ نَقْصُصْ عَلَيْكَؕ وَمَا كَانَ لِرَسُوْلٍ اَنْ يَّاْتِىَ بِاٰيَةٍ اِلَّا بِاِذْنِ اللّٰه‌ِۚ فَاِذَا جَآءَ اَمْرُ اللّٰهِ قُضِىَ بِالْحَقِّ وَخَسِرَ هُنَالِكَ الْمُبْطِلُوْنَ‏(78)
verses.translation: (78) And certainly We sent apostles before you: there are some of them that We have mentioned to you and there are others whom We have not mentioned to you, and it was not meet for an apostle that he should bring a sign except with Allah's permission, but when the command of Allah came, Judgement was given with truth, and those who treated (it) as a lie were lost.

verses.arabic: اَللّٰهُ الَّذِىْ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الْاَنْعَامَ لِتَرْكَبُوْا مِنْهَا وَمِنْهَا تَاْكُلُوْنَ‏(79)
verses.translation: (79) Allah is He Who made the cattle for you that you may ride on some of them, and some of them you eat.

verses.arabic: وَلَكُمْ فِيْهَا مَنَافِعُ وَ لِتَبْلُغُوْا عَلَيْهَا حَاجَةً فِىْ صُدُوْرِكُمْ وَعَلَيْهَا وَعَلَى الْفُلْكِ تُحْمَلُوْنَؕ‏(80)
verses.translation: (80) And there are advantages for you in them, and that you may attain thereon a want which is in your breasts, and upon them and upon the ships you are borne.

verses.arabic: وَيُرِيْكُمْ اٰيٰتِهٖ ۖ  فَاَىَّ اٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِ تُنْكِرُوْنَ‏(81)
verses.translation: (81) And He shows you His signs: which then of Allah's signs will you deny?

verses.arabic: اَفَلَمْ يَسِيْرُوْا فِى الْاَرْضِ فَيَنْظُرُوْا كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الَّذِيْنَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْؕ كَانُوْۤا اَكْثَرَ مِنْهُمْ وَاَشَدَّ قُوَّةً وَّ اٰثَارًا فِى الْاَرْضِ فَمَاۤ اَغْنٰى عَنْهُمْ مَّا كَانُوْا يَكْسِبُوْنَ‏(82)
verses.translation: (82) Have they not then journeyed in the land and seen how was the end of those before them? They were more (in numbers) than these and greater in strength and in fortifications in the land, but what they earned did not avail them.

verses.arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُهُمْ بِالْبَيِّنٰتِ فَرِحُوْا بِمَا عِنْدَهُمْ مِّنَ الْعِلْمِ وَحَاقَ بِهِمْ مَّا كَانُوْا بِهٖ يَسْتَهْزِءُوْنَ‏(83)
verses.translation: (83) Then when their apostles came to them with clear arguments, they exulted in what they had with them of knowledge, and there beset them that which they used to mock.

verses.arabic: فَلَمَّا رَاَوْا بَاْسَنَا قَالُوْۤا اٰمَنَّا بِاللّٰهِ وَحْدَهٗ وَكَفَرْنَا بِمَا كُنَّا بِهٖ مُشْرِكِيْنَ‏(84)
verses.translation: (84) But when they saw Our punishment, they said: We believe in Allah alone and we deny what we used to associate with Him.

verses.arabic: فَلَمْ يَكُ يَنْفَعُهُمْ اِيْمَانُهُمْ لَمَّا رَاَوْا بَاْسَنَا ؕ سُنَّتَ اللّٰهِ الَّتِىْ قَدْ خَلَتْ فِىْ عِبَادِهٖ‌ۚ وَخَسِرَ هُنَالِكَ الْكٰفِرُوْنَ‏(85)
verses.translation: (85) But their belief was not going to profit them when they had seen Our punishment; (this is) Allah's law, which has indeed obtained in the matter of His servants, and there the unbelievers are lost.

verses.arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِيْمِ

verses.translation: (1) Ha Mim!

verses.arabic: تَنْزِيْلٌ مِّنَ الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِيْمِ‌ۚ‏(2)
verses.translation: (2) A revelation from the Beneficent, the Merciful Allah:

verses.arabic: كِتٰبٌ فُصِّلَتْ اٰيٰتُهٗ قُرْاٰنًا عَرَبِيًّا لِّقَوْمٍ يَّعْلَمُوْنَۙ‏(3)
verses.translation: (3) A Book of which the verses are made plain, an Arabic Quran for a people who know:

verses.arabic: بَشِيْرًا وَّنَذِيْرًا‌ ۚ فَاَعْرَضَ اَكْثَرُهُمْ فَهُمْ لَا يَسْمَعُوْنَ‏(4)
verses.translation: (4) A herald of good news and a warner, but most of them turn aside so they hear not.

verses.arabic: وَقَالُوْا قُلُوْبُنَا فِىْۤ اَكِنَّةٍ مِّمَّا تَدْعُوْنَاۤ اِلَيْهِ وَفِىْۤ اٰذَانِنَا وَقْرٌ وَّمِنْۢ بَيْنِنَا وَبَيْنِكَ حِجَابٌ فَاعْمَلْ اِنَّنَا عٰمِلُوْنَ‏(5)
verses.translation: (5) And they say: Our hearts are under coverings from that to which you call us, and there is a heaviness in our ears, and a veil hangs between us and you, so work, we too are working.

verses.arabic: قُلْ اِنَّمَاۤ اَنَا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُكُمْ يُوْحٰٓى اِلَىَّ اَنَّمَاۤ اِلٰهُكُمْ اِلٰهٌ وَّاحِدٌ فَاسْتَقِيْمُوْۤا اِلَيْهِ وَاسْتَغْفِرُوْهُ‌ ؕ وَوَيْلٌ لِّلْمُشْرِكِيْنَ ۙ‏(6)
verses.translation: (6) Say: I am only a mortal like you; it is revealed to me that your Allah is one Allah, therefore follow the right way to Him and ask His forgiveness; and woe to the polytheists;

verses.arabic: الَّذِيْنَ لَا يُؤْتُوْنَ الزَّكٰوةَ وَهُمْ بِالْاٰخِرَةِ هُمْ كٰفِرُوْنَ‏(7)
verses.translation: (7) (To) those who do not give poor-rate and they are unbelievers in the hereafter.

verses.arabic: اِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ لَهُمْ اَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُوْنٍ‏(8)
verses.translation: (8) (As for) those who believe and do good, they shall surely have a reward never to be cut off.

verses.arabic: قُلْ اَئِنَّكُمْ لَتَكْفُرُوْنَ بِالَّذِىْ خَلَقَ الْاَرْضَ فِىْ يَوْمَيْنِ وَتَجْعَلُوْنَ لَهٗۤ اَنْدَادًا‌ؕ ذٰلِكَ رَبُّ الْعٰلَمِيْنَ‌ۚ‏(9)
verses.translation: (9) Say: What! do you indeed disbelieve in Him Who created the earth in two periods, and do you set up equals with Him? That is the Lord of the Worlds.

verses.arabic: وَجَعَلَ فِيْهَا رَوَاسِىَ مِنْ فَوْقِهَا وَبٰرَكَ فِيْهَا وَقَدَّرَ فِيْهَاۤ اَقْوَاتَهَا فِىْۤ اَرْبَعَةِ اَيَّامٍؕ سَوَآءً لِّلسَّآئِلِيْنَ‏(10)
verses.translation: (10) And He made in it mountains above its surface, and He blessed therein and made therein its foods, in four periods: alike for the seekers.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ اسْتَوٰۤى اِلَى السَّمَآءِ وَهِىَ دُخَانٌ فَقَالَ لَهَا وَلِلْاَرْضِ ائْتِيَا طَوْعًا اَوْ كَرْهًا ؕ قَالَتَاۤ اَتَيْنَا طَآئِعِيْنَ‏(11)
verses.translation: (11) Then He directed Himself to the heaven and it is a vapor, so He said to it and to the earth: Come both, willingly or unwillingly. They both said: We come willingly.

verses.arabic: فَقَضٰٮهُنَّ سَبْعَ سَمٰوَاتٍ فِىْ يَوْمَيْنِ وَاَوْحٰى فِىْ كُلِّ سَمَآءٍ اَمْرَهَا‌ ؕ وَزَ يَّنَّا السَّمَآءَ الدُّنْيَا بِمَصَابِيْحَ ‌ۖ  وَحِفْظًا ‌ؕ ذٰ لِكَ تَقْدِيْرُ الْعَزِيْزِ الْعَلِيْمِ‏(12)
verses.translation: (12) So He ordained them seven heavens in two periods, and revealed in every heaven its affair; and We adorned the lower heaven with brilliant stars and (made it) to guard; that is the decree of the Mighty, the Knowing.

verses.arabic: فَاِنْ اَعْرَضُوْا فَقُلْ اَنْذَرْتُكُمْ صٰعِقَةً مِّثْلَ صٰعِقَةِ عَادٍ وَّثَمُوْدَ ؕ‏(13)
verses.translation: (13) But if they turn aside, then say: I have warned you of a scourge like the scourge of Ad and Samood.

verses.arabic: اِذْ جَآءَتْهُمُ الرُّسُلُ مِنْۢ بَيْنِ اَيْدِيْهِمْ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِمْ اَلَّا تَعْبُدُوْۤا اِلَّا اللّٰهَ‌ؕ قَالُوْا لَوْ شَآءَ رَبُّنَا لَاَنْزَلَ مَلٰٓئِكَةً فَاِنَّا بِمَاۤ اُرْسِلْتُمْ بِهٖ كٰفِرُوْنَ‏(14)
verses.translation: (14) When their apostles came to them from before them and from behind them, saying, Serve nothing but Allah, they said: If our Lord had pleased He would certainly have sent down angels, so we are surely unbelievers in that with which you are sent.

verses.arabic: فَاَمَّا عَادٌ فَاسْتَكْبَرُوْا فِى الْاَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ الْحَقِّ وَقَالُوْا مَنْ اَشَدُّ مِنَّا قُوَّةً  ‌ؕ اَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا اَنَّ اللّٰهَ الَّذِىْ خَلَقَهُمْ هُوَ اَشَدُّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةً  ؕ وَكَانُوْا بِاٰيٰتِنَا يَجْحَدُوْنَ‏(15)
verses.translation: (15) Then as to Ad, they were unjustly proud in the land, and they said: Who is mightier in strength than we? Did they not see that Allah Who created them was mightier than they in strength, and they denied Our communications?

verses.arabic: فَاَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيْحًا صَرْصَرًا فِىْۤ اَيَّامٍ نَّحِسَاتٍ لِّنُذِيْقَهُمْ عَذَابَ الْخِزْىِ فِى الْحَيٰوةِ الدُّنْيَا‌ ؕ وَلَعَذَابُ الْاٰخِرَةِ اَخْزٰى‌ وَهُمْ لَا يُنْصَرُوْنَ‏(16)
verses.translation: (16) So We sent on them a furious wind in unlucky days, that We may make them taste the chastisement of abasement in this world's life; and certainly the chastisement of the hereafter is much more abasing, and they shall not be helped.

verses.arabic: وَاَمَّا ثَمُوْدُ فَهَدَيْنٰهُمْ فَاسْتَحَبُّوا الْعَمٰى عَلَى الْهُدٰى فَاَخَذَتْهُمْ صٰعِقَةُ الْعَذَابِ الْهُوْنِ بِمَا كَانُوْا يَكْسِبُوْنَ‌ۚ‏(17)
verses.translation: (17) And as to Samood, We showed them the right way, but they chose error above guidance, so there overtook them the scourge of an abasing chastisement for what they earned.

verses.arabic: وَ نَجَّيْنَا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَكَانُوْا يَتَّقُوْنَ‏(18)
verses.translation: (18) And We delivered those who believed and guarded (against evil).

verses.arabic: وَيَوْمَ يُحْشَرُ اَعْدَآءُ اللّٰهِ اِلَى النَّارِ فَهُمْ يُوْزَعُوْنَ‏(19)
verses.translation: (19) And on the day that the enemies of Allah shall be brought together to the fire, then they shall be formed into groups.

verses.arabic: حَتّٰٓى اِذَا مَا جَآءُوْهَا شَهِدَ عَلَيْهِمْ سَمْعُهُمْ وَاَبْصَارُهُمْ وَجُلُوْدُهُمْ بِمَا كَانُوْا يَعْمَلُوْنَ‏(20)
verses.translation: (20) Until when they come to it, their ears and their eyes and their skins shall bear witness against them as to what they did.

verses.arabic: وَقَالُوْا لِجُلُوْدِهِمْ لِمَ شَهِدْتُّمْ عَلَيْنَا‌ ؕ قَالُوْۤا اَنْطَقَنَا اللّٰهُ الَّذِىْۤ اَنْطَقَ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ وَّهُوَ خَلَقَكُمْ اَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ وَّاِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُوْنَ‏(21)
verses.translation: (21) And they shall say to their skins: Why have you borne witness against us? They shall say: Allah Who makes everything speak has made us speak, and He created you at first, and to Him you shall be brought back.

verses.arabic: وَمَا كُنْتُمْ تَسْتَتِرُوْنَ اَنْ يَّشْهَدَ عَلَيْكُمْ سَمْعُكُمْ وَلَاۤ اَبْصَارُكُمْ وَلَا جُلُوْدُكُمْ وَلٰكِنْ ظَنَنْتُمْ اَنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا يَعْلَمُ كَثِيْرًا مِّمَّا تَعْمَلُوْنَ‏(22)
verses.translation: (22) And you did not veil yourselves lest your ears and your eyes and your skins should bear witness against you, but you thought that Allah did not know most of what you did.

verses.arabic: وَذٰلِكُمْ ظَنُّكُمُ الَّذِىْ ظَنَنْتُمْ بِرَبِّكُمْ اَرْدٰٮكُمْ فَاَصْبَحْتُمْ مِّنَ الْخٰسِرِيْنَ‏(23)
verses.translation: (23) And that was your (evil) thought which you entertained about your Lord that has tumbled you down into perdition, so are you become of the lost ones.

verses.arabic: فَاِنْ يَّصْبِرُوْا فَالنَّارُ مَثْوًى لَّهُمْ‌ؕ وَاِنْ يَّسْتَعْتِبُوْا فَمَا هُمْ مِّنَ الْمُعْتَبِيْنَ‏(24)
verses.translation: (24) Then if they will endure, still the fire is their abode, and if they ask for goodwill, then are they not of those who shall be granted goodwill.

verses.arabic: وَقَيَّضْنَا لَهُمْ قُرَنَآءَ فَزَيَّنُوْا لَهُمْ مَّا بَيْنَ اَيْدِيْهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَحَقَّ عَلَيْهِمُ الْقَوْلُ فِىْۤ اُمَمٍ قَدْ خَلَتْ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ مِّنَ الْجِنِّ وَالْاِنْسِ‌ۚ اِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْا خٰسِرِيْنَ‏(25)
verses.translation: (25) And We have appointed for them comrades so they have made fair-seeming to them what is before them and what is behind them, and the word proved true against them-- among the nations of the jinn and the men that have passed away before them-- that they shall surely be losers.

verses.arabic: وَقَالَ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا لَا تَسْمَعُوْا لِهٰذَا الْقُرْاٰنِ وَالْغَوْا فِيْهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَغْلِبُوْنَ‏(26)
verses.translation: (26) And those who disbelieve say: Do not listen to this Quran and make noise therein, perhaps you may overcome.

verses.arabic: فَلَنُذِيْقَنَّ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا عَذَابًا شَدِيْدًاۙ وَّلَنَجْزِيَنَّهُمْ اَسْوَاَ الَّذِىْ كَانُوْا يَعْمَلُوْنَ‏(27)
verses.translation: (27) Therefore We will most certainly make those who disbelieve taste a severe punishment, and We will most certainly reward them for the evil deeds they used to do.

verses.arabic: ذٰ لِكَ جَزَآءُ اَعْدَآءِ اللّٰهِ النَّارُ‌ ۚ لَهُمْ فِيْهَا دَارُ الْخُلْدِ‌ ؕ جَزَآءًۢ بِمَا كَانُوْا بِاٰيٰتِنَا يَجْحَدُوْنَ‏(28)
verses.translation: (28) That is the reward of the enemies of Allah-- the fire; for them therein shall be the house of long abiding; a reward for their denying Our communications.

verses.arabic: وَقَالَ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا رَبَّنَاۤ اَرِنَا الَّذَيْنِ اَضَلّٰنَا مِنَ الْجِنِّ وَالْاِنْسِ نَجْعَلْهُمَا تَحْتَ اَقْدَامِنَا لِيَكُوْنَا مِنَ الْاَسْفَلِيْنَ‏(29)
verses.translation: (29) And those who disbelieve will say: Our Lord! show us those who led us astray from among the jinn and the men that we may trample them under our feet so that they may be of the lowest.

verses.arabic: اِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ قَالُوْا رَبُّنَا اللّٰهُ ثُمَّ اسْتَقَامُوْا تَتَنَزَّلُ عَلَيْهِمُ الْمَلٰٓئِكَةُ اَلَّا تَخَافُوْا وَلَا تَحْزَنُوْا وَاَبْشِرُوْا بِالْجَنَّةِ الَّتِىْ كُنْتُمْ تُوْعَدُوْنَ‏(30)
verses.translation: (30) (As for) those who say: Our Lord is Allah, then continue in the right way, the angels descend upon them, saying: Fear not, nor be grieved, and receive good news of the garden which you were promised.

verses.arabic: نَحْنُ اَوْلِيٰٓؤُکُمْ فِى الْحَيٰوةِ الدُّنْيَا وَفِى الْاٰخِرَةِ ۚ وَلَكُمْ فِيْهَا مَا تَشْتَهِىْۤ اَنْفُسُكُمْ وَلَكُمْ فِيْهَا مَا تَدَّعُوْنَ ؕ‏(31)
verses.translation: (31) We are your guardians in this world's life and in the hereafter, and you shall have therein what your souls desire and you shall have therein what you ask for:

verses.arabic: نُزُلًا مِّنْ غَفُوْرٍ رَّحِيْمٍ‏(32)
verses.translation: (32) A provision from the Forgiving, the Merciful.

verses.arabic: وَمَنْ اَحْسَنُ قَوْلًا مِّمَّنْ دَعَاۤ اِلَى اللّٰهِ وَعَمِلَ صَالِحًا وَّقَالَ اِنَّنِىْ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِيْنَ‏(33)
verses.translation: (33) And who speaks better than he who calls to Allah while he himself does good, and says: I am surely of those who submit?

verses.arabic: وَلَا تَسْتَوِى الْحَسَنَةُ وَ لَا السَّيِّئَةُ ؕ اِدْفَعْ بِالَّتِىْ هِىَ اَحْسَنُ فَاِذَا الَّذِىْ بَيْنَكَ وَبَيْنَهٗ عَدَاوَةٌ كَاَنَّهٗ وَلِىٌّ حَمِيْمٌ‏(34)
verses.translation: (34) And not alike are the good and the evil. Repel (evil) with what is best, when lo! he between whom and you was enmity would be as if he were a warm friend.

verses.arabic: وَمَا يُلَقّٰٮهَاۤ اِلَّا الَّذِيْنَ صَبَرُوْا‌ۚ وَمَا يُلَقّٰٮهَاۤ اِلَّا ذُوْ حَظٍّ عَظِيْمٍ‏(35)
verses.translation: (35) And none are made to receive it but those who are patient, and none are made to receive it but those who have a mighty good fortune.

verses.arabic: وَاِمَّا يَنْزَغَنَّكَ مِنَ الشَّيْطٰنِ نَزْغٌ فَاسْتَعِذْ بِاللّٰهِ‌ؕ اِنَّهٗ هُوَ السَّمِيْعُ الْعَلِيْمُ‏(36)
verses.translation: (36) And if an interference of the Shaitan should cause you mischief, seek refuge in Allah; surely He is the Hearing, the Knowing.

verses.arabic: وَمِنْ اٰيٰتِهِ الَّيْلُ وَالنَّهَارُ وَالشَّمْسُ وَالْقَمَرُ‌ؕ لَا تَسْجُدُوْا لِلشَّمْسِ وَلَا لِلْقَمَرِ وَاسْجُدُوْا لِلّٰهِ الَّذِىْ خَلَقَهُنَّ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ اِيَّاهُ تَعْبُدُوْنَ‏(37)
verses.translation: (37) And among His signs are the night and the day and the sun and the moon; do not prostrate to the sun nor to the moon; and prostrate to Allah Who created them, if Him it is that you serve.

verses.arabic: فَاِنِ اسْتَكْبَرُوْا فَالَّذِيْنَ عِنْدَ رَبِّكَ يُسَبِّحُوْنَ لَهٗ بِالَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ وَهُمْ لَا يَسْئَمُوْنَ۩‏(38)
verses.translation: (38) But if they are proud, yet those with your Lord glorify Him during the night and the day, and they are not tired.

verses.arabic: وَمِنْ اٰيٰتِهٖۤ اَنَّكَ تَرَى الْاَرْضَ خَاشِعَةً فَاِذَاۤ اَنْزَلْنَا عَلَيْهَا الْمَآءَ اهْتَزَّتْ وَرَبَتْ‌ؕ اِنَّ الَّذِىْۤ اَحْيَاهَا لَمُحْىِ الْمَوْتٰى ؕ اِنَّهٗ عَلٰى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيْرٌ‏(39)
verses.translation: (39) And among His signs is this, that you see the earth still, but when We send down on it the water, it stirs and swells: most surely He Who gives it life is the Giver of life to the dead; surely He has power over all things.

verses.arabic: اِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ يُلْحِدُوْنَ فِىْۤ اٰيٰتِنَا لَا يَخْفَوْنَ عَلَيْنَا ؕ اَفَمَنْ يُّلْقٰى فِى النَّارِ خَيْرٌ اَمْ مَّنْ يَّاْتِىْۤ اٰمِنًا يَّوْمَ الْقِيٰمَةِ‌ ؕ اِعْمَلُوْا مَا شِئْتُمْ‌ ۙ اِنَّهٗ بِمَا تَعْمَلُوْنَ بَصِيْرٌ‏(40)
verses.translation: (40) Surely they who deviate from the right way concerning Our communications are not hidden from Us. What! is he then who is cast into the fire better, or he who comes safe on the day of resurrection? Do what you like, surely He sees what you do.

verses.arabic: اِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا بِالذِّكْرِ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ‌ۚ وَاِنَّهٗ لَكِتٰبٌ عَزِيْزٌۙ‏(41)
verses.translation: (41) Surely those who disbelieve in the reminder when it comes to them, and most surely it is a Mighty Book:

verses.arabic: لَّا يَاْتِيْهِ الْبَاطِلُ مِنْۢ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَلَا مِنْ خَلْفِهٖ‌ؕ تَنْزِيْلٌ مِّنْ حَكِيْمٍ حَمِيْدٍ‏(42)
verses.translation: (42) Falsehood shall not come to it from before it nor from behind it; a revelation from the Wise, the Praised One.

verses.arabic: مَا يُقَالُ لَكَ اِلَّا مَا قَدْ قِيْلَ لِلرُّسُلِ مِنْ قَبْلِكَ ‌ؕ اِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَذُوْ مَغْفِرَةٍ وَّذُوْ عِقَابٍ اَ لِيْمٍ‏(43)
verses.translation: (43) Naught is said to you but what was said indeed to the apostles before you; surely your Lord is the Lord of forgiveness and the Lord of painful retribution.

verses.arabic: وَلَوْ جَعَلْنٰهُ قُرْاٰنًا اَعْجَمِيًّا لَّقَالُوْا لَوْلَا فُصِّلَتْ اٰيٰتُهٗ ؕ ءَؔاَعْجَمِىٌّ وَّعَرَبِىٌّ‌  ؕ قُلْ هُوَ لِلَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا هُدًى وَشِفَآءٌ‌  ؕ وَ الَّذِيْنَ لَا يُؤْمِنُوْنَ فِىْۤ اٰذَانِهِمْ وَقْرٌ وَّهُوَ عَلَيْهِمْ عَمًى‌ ؕ اُولٰٓئِكَ يُنَادَوْنَ مِنْ مَّكَانٍۢ بَعِيْدٍ‏(44)
verses.translation: (44) And if We had made it a Quran in a foreign tongue, they would certainly have said: Why have not its communications been made clear? What! a foreign (tongue) and an Arabian! Say: It is to those who believe a guidance and a healing; and (as for) those who do not believe, there is a heaviness in their ears and it is obscure to them; these shall be called to from a far-off place.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ اٰتَيْنَا مُوْسَى الْكِتٰبَ فَاخْتُلِفَ فِيْهِ‌ؕ وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةٌ سَبَقَتْ مِنْ رَّبِّكَ لَقُضِىَ بَيْنَهُمْ‌ؕ وَاِنَّهُمْ لَفِىْ شَكٍّ مِّنْهُ مُرِيْبٍ‏(45)
verses.translation: (45) And certainly We gave the Book to Musa, but it has been differed about, and had not a word already gone forth from your Lord, Judgement would certainly have been given between them; and most surely they are in a disquieting doubt about it.

verses.arabic: مَنْ عَمِلَ صَالِحًا فَلِنَفْسِهٖ‌ وَمَنْ اَسَآءَ فَعَلَيْهَا‌ؕ وَمَا رَبُّكَ بِظَلَّامٍ لِّلْعَبِيْدِ‏(46)
verses.translation: (46) Whoever does good, it is for his own soul, and whoever does evil, it is against it; and your Lord is not in the least unjust to the servants.
